title: Why I still sound like 1994
hook: people ask why my stuff sounds old.
body:
grew up on waylon and merle. never grew out of it.

new record's got that 90s neo-traditional sound the whole way through. on purpose.

script.visual: drop the needle on a Waylon or Merle record
script.line: people ask why my stuff sounds old.

script.visual: record spinning, then HARD CUT to the band playing
script.line: so i made a whole record that sounds like it.

script.visual: band locked into the neo-trad groove, nod
script.line: boat’s the first one. out now.

shot_list: turntable + record close-up (a real Waylon or Merle record) for the visual
hard cut to the band playing the EP groove. IMPORTANT: use YOUR music for the audio, the records are visual only
media_notes: Poster graphic (no photo needed). The clip itself is Ben filmed to the shot list.
notes: Owns the 90s neo-trad identity (real: influences Waylon & Merle, per Ben’s bio).
